business_problem: Polpo needed to automate political and parliamentary monitoring because analysts were spending too much time manually searching many disparate data sources and could not efficiently surface the context relevant to specific organizations or stakeholders.
solution_summary: Polpo built a political-monitoring platform around IBM text-analytics technology to capture and analyze Dutch parliamentary data in near real time. The company aggregated open-source political data into its own database and dashboard, then used IBM Watson Explorer together with IBM Content Analytics Studio, now part of IBM Watson Discovery, to enrich the content and generate AI-based models. This let Polpo move beyond keyword matching and identify the context around ambiguous political terms by using secondary-word patterns and continuously refined models. The platform then exposed the results through a subscription web application where public-affairs professionals can filter, search, and monitor issues relevant to their organizations. Because the system was designed for continuous development, Polpo could keep adding dashboards and data sources without having development effort scale linearly, creating a practical production system rather than a proof of concept.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Explorer
solution_components.role: Provides context-aware text analytics that help Polpo interpret political language and surface relevant content.

solution_components.name: IBM Content Analytics Studio
solution_components.role: Supports document aggregation and model generation for the political-monitoring workflow.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Discovery
solution_components.role: Represents the evolved IBM document-intelligence capability within the platform's broader analytics landscape.

data_flow: Political and governmental data from online sources is aggregated into Polpo's database, IBM text-analytics components enrich and classify the content, and the platform delivers filtered results through dashboards and subscription views for public-affairs professionals.
business_outcome: Polpo gave users faster access to relevant political intelligence, reduced manual research time, and created a scalable subscription service for public-affairs monitoring.
